item.title: Junction of Neal and Monmouth Street and Shaftesbury Avenue, 17th October
item.description:
Vehicles Northbound on Neal Street are supposed to turn L onto Monmouth Street and not go onto Shaftesbury Avenue. The signage does not indicate this clearly and many vehicles ignore this. It is extremely dangerous for cyclists especially on the new cycle lane on Shaftesbury Avenue. The signage must be improved and enforcement take place.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 80, Neal Street, Bloomsbury, Greater London
